notes: Executor harness + grading: see README.md 'Skill evals'. Each eval copies fixtures/demo-repo to a temp dir, git-inits and commits it as the seed, then a fresh subagent executes skills/run/SKILL.md as /flywheel:run in that dir. Grade with: bash skills/run/evals/check.sh <id> <workdir>.

evals.name: happy-path-persist
evals.setup: cp -r skills/run/evals/fixtures/demo-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: The run follows the contract's fixed rules, persists the audit row per DATA.md and proves it, and regenerates the telemetry report.
expectations: data/plate-audits.md gains the row '| 9876 KZX | 9876 | KZX | 30 |' with today's date — the exact deterministic fields Rule 3 fixes
The write landed per DATA.md: data/plate-audits.md has no unstaged modification (staged or committed)
The seeded row for 1234 BCD is untouched

evals.name: idempotent-upsert
evals.setup: cp -r skills/run/evals/fixtures/demo-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: The plate already has a seeded row; the run updates it in place instead of appending a duplicate.
expectations: Exactly one row for plate 1234 BCD exists in data/plate-audits.md after the run
The row's deterministic fields are still digits=1234, letters=BCD, digit_sum=10
No unstaged modification of data/plate-audits.md remains

evals.name: guardrail-invalid-input
evals.setup: cp -r skills/run/evals/fixtures/demo-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: AEI contains vowels, so Rule 2 fails: the run records a rejection and produces no audit row — it must not fabricate fields to look complete.
expectations: No audit row containing 'AEI' appears in the Audits table
A rejection line mentioning the input is appended under ## Rejections
The seeded row for 1234 BCD is untouched
